sentences.en: Put the meat in the refrigerator, or it will rot.
sentences.zh: 把肉放进冰箱里，否则它会腐烂。

sentences.en: When you're green, you grow. When you're ripe, you rot.
sentences.zh: 青的时候你成长；熟的时候你就会腐烂。

sentences.en: The Rotes Rathaus is the town hall of Berlin.
sentences.zh: 柏林市政厅就是罗腾贝格市政厅。

senses.zh: （使）腐烂，腐朽；腐败；（使）堕落；逐渐恶化；取笑
腐烂，腐败；形势恶化；（尤指植物的）枯病；蠢话
